text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.
- The Association of Macedonian Painters organised an exhibition of Macedonian art in Paris. The exhibition was opened by Macedonian ambassador to France Luan Starova.

- Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov congratulated U.S. President Bill Clinton for his electoral victory. Macedonia appreciates U.S. efforts for peace and stability in the world, especially in the Balkan region, he said.
- Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov congratulates new Bulgarian president Petar Stojanov. Macedonia hopes to have better and closer relations with Bulgaria.
- Germany to help Macedonia on its association with the EU, said Macedonian Deputy Prime Minister Jane Miljovski. There is a possibiloity of organising a donors' conference for Macedonia.

- The President of PDP (ethnic Alabnains) Abdurahman Aliti said "the Macedonian President Gligorov made a mistake saying Albanians could never become a constituent nation in Macedonia. All Albanian parties in the country have this goal in their programmes".
